# 견적검수실 데이터

Updated: 2026-09-11

This preview separates OFFICIAL, REFERENCE, QUOTE and CALCULATED data. Do not treat public construction standards as private apartment market averages.

## Primary datasets
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/cost-index/ — official construction cost index
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/construction-wage/ — official construction wage survey
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/ — public construction unit-cost references; not private market prices
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/quote-statistics/ — anonymized quote aggregates; prices withheld below N thresholds
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/catalog/ — dataset catalog and scopes
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/answers/ — concise answer index for common questions
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/dataset-catalog.json — machine-readable dataset catalog
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/answer-index.json — machine-readable answer index
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/quote-intelligence.json — quote coverage and publication status

## Quote publication policy
Overall distribution requires N>=30. Segment price distributions require N>=20. Raw quote rows are not published. Mean is not published.

## v8 endpoints
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost-v8.json — curated 2026-H2 interior-adjacent public unit costs; reference only
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/citation-map.json — claim provenance and interpretation limits
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/query-map.json — search-intent to canonical page map; no search-volume claims
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/quote-compare/ — three-quote condition normalizer; no automatic vendor recommendation

## Public unit-cost topic pages
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/waterproof/ — 방수 단가; 21 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/tile/ — 타일 시공 단가; 11 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/window-sealing/ — 창호·실링 단가; 7 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/wallpaper/ — 도배 단가; 3 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/carpentry-drywall/ — 목공·석고·천장 단가; 18 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/flooring/ — 바닥·걸레받이 단가; 7 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/paint/ — 도장 단가; 4 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/insulation/ — 단열 시공 단가; 8 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/base-finishing/ — 바탕·미장 단가; 11 selected items; public construction reference, not private market price

## v10 routes and tools
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/region/ — 17 region quote-status hubs; do not infer prices from other regions
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/region-pyeong-map.json — 85 region × pyeong cells; price pages require N>=20
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/quote-paste/ — local text classifier; no OCR and no server upload
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/cost-combination/ — scope coverage tool; public unit prices are not summed across incompatible specifications
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/answers-v10/ — 78 evidence-linked Q&A records
